\section{Claim ladder and methods contribution}
\label{sec:claim-ladder-methods}

The current contribution is a diagnostic-algebra and governance
method, not an anomaly-detection claim.  It follows the same
principle used by blinded cosmological analyses and multiverse
analysis: analysis choices, thresholds, and allowed interpretations
are registered before headline interpretation, so scalar summaries
cannot be promoted after the fact into stronger claims
\cite{Muir2020Blinding,Steegen2016Multiverse,GelmanLoken2013Forking}.
Planck and WMAP Bianchi studies provide the external morphology and
isotropy context, including negative results for physically coupled
Bianchi VIIh components; they are not evidence that the present
repository has a native low-ell atlas
\cite{McEwen2013BianchiWMAP,Planck2013XXIII,Planck2018VII}.

The admissible claim ladder is:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textbf{C\arabic*.},leftmargin=*]
\item $x_C$ is an exact signed comparator projection under the stated
Bianchi/perfect-fluid assumptions.  Its sign and comparator label are
part of the claim.
\item Cancellation is exact: a small $x_C$ or $F$ can coexist with
large signed sectors.  Sector profiles, cancellation index, and an
unsigned magnitude companion are required before interpretation.
\item MIO owns diagnostic-only certificates, including $(x,Q,\Pi,F,G_F)$
reports and direction/depth coherence.  MIO does not own posterior odds,
Bayes factors, model ranking, evidence, or truth-certification authority.
\item $F$ is supported only as a fail-closed, budget-normalised signed
projection when the denominator policy and admissible ceiling are
recorded.  It is not physical volume occupancy.
\item $\Pi$ is supported only as a registered exceedance curve with a
declared measure, threshold policy, look-elsewhere metadata, and null
status.  It is not a truth probability or calibrated p-value unless a
matched-null calibration exists.
\item $G_F$ is supported only with a denominator-evolution split, raw and
floor-applied per-bin $F$ values, and explicit local/systematic null
status.
\item Detection, native-transfer validation, anisotropic-geometry
detection, and Bianchi family-ID are forbidden current
claims.
\item Local/global discrimination is forecast-only at the current gate:
the matched-null path is specified, but observed-data wording remains
blocked until rank, covariance, null, PPC/LOOCV, and native-atlas gates
close.
\end{enumerate}

The methods novelty can therefore be stated without overclaiming:
F1 is the machine-checkable semantic firewall that binds symbols,
owners, artifact modes, and forbidden uses; F2 is the signed comparator
projection $x_C$; F3 is cancellation-aware display metadata; F4 is
the comparator-multiverse $Q$ discipline; F5 is registered exceedance
semantics for $\Pi$; F6 is fail-closed certified $F$; F7 is the
denominator-split $G_F$ depth diagnostic; F8 is strict MIO/HTT/BASS
ownership separation; and F9 is manifest-backed publication/audit
packaging.  The flagship result is F1: every downstream quantity is
interpretable only inside an executable claim lane.

The current limitations are equally part of the result.  There is no
current detection claim, no native low-ell solver output, no native
morphology atlas, no Bianchi family-ID, and no observed-data
local/global separation.  Current transfer-dependent surfaces remain
transfer-conditional, and the $G_F$ matched-null false-positive-rate
gate is explicitly blocked under the available null banks.
